title: BernBRS: Certified Backward Reachability for Deep Bernstein Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.22083v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ensuring the safety of complex neural network systems requires mathematically rigorous verification. While backward reachability analysis is a critical tool for identifying safe initial states, computing tight, formal bounds remains notoriously difficult to scale. Recent advancements have demonstrated that DeepBern-Nets neural networks utilizing Bernstein polynomial activation functions possess advantageous mathematical properties that enable exceptionally fast and tight forward reachability analysis. Building upon this efficiency, this paper introduces BernBRS, a highly accurate and scalable framework for the backward reachability analysis of DeepBern-Nets. BernBRS simultaneously computes certified inner and outer approximations of the Backward Reachable Set (BRS). Rather than relying on single convex bounding, our method intelligently refines a cover of the input space by analyzing activation patterns, splitting the input domain precis

translated_title: BernBRS：深度伯恩斯坦神经网络的认证后向可达性分析
translated_abstract: 确保复杂神经网络系统的安全性需要数学上严格的验证。虽然后向可达性分析是识别安全初始状态的关键工具，但计算紧凑的形式化边界仍然出了名地难以扩展。最近的进展表明，采用伯恩斯坦多项式激活函数的DeepBern-Nets神经网络具有优越的数学特性，能够实现极其快速且紧凑的前向可达性分析。基于这种高效性，本文提出了BernBRS，一个用于DeepBern-Nets后向可达性分析的高精度且可扩展的框架。BernBRS同时计算后向可达集（BRS）的认证内近似和外近似。我们的方法不依赖于单一的凸包络边界，而是通过分析激活模式智能地细化输入空间的覆盖，精确地分割输入域……
tldr: 本文提出BernBRS框架，通过分析激活模式对输入空间覆盖进行智能细化与精确分割，为深度伯恩斯坦神经网络同时计算后向可达集的认证内、外近似，实现了高精度且可扩展的后向可达性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BernBRS, a certified, accurate, and scalable backward reachability analysis framework for DeepBern-Nets that simultaneously computes inner and outer approximations of the Backward Reachable Set by intelligently refining the input space cover through activation pattern analysis.
